factorRatings.note: The Infatuation scored it 8.4 ('great'), calling the cracker-thin, diamond-cut tavern pie 'the pizza to beat here' and comparing its deep dish favorably to Lou Malnati's and Giordano's. Seattle Met covers owner Shawn Millard's 2022 move from takeout-only into a full West Seattle restaurant and the tavern pie's roots as a tribute to Chicago's Vito & Nick's Pizzeria.
